features: 【All-in-One printer】Experience the convenience of multi-functionality with the HP Smart Tank 580 printer. It can print, copy, and scan, ensuring sharp scans with its flatbed scanner.
【Seamless connectivity】Stay connected with Wi-Fi and Hi-Speed USB 2.0. This printer also supports Wi-Fi Direct for an even more streamlined printing experience.

【Quality prints】Create high-quality prints with HP GT53 90-ml/ HP GT53XL 135-ml Black Original Ink Bottle and HP GT52 Cyan/Magenta/Yellow Original Ink Bottle for superior print quality, Maximum Print Speed : 30 ppm Black, 24 ppm color
【Warranty and support】The HP Smart Tank 580 printer comes with a 1-year warranty. Reach out to our 12x7 voice support or 24x7 chat support for quick assistance.
【Fast printing】With a print speed of up to 30 ppm (black) and 24 ppm (color), get your printing tasks done quicker than ever with first page out as fast as 14 seconds
【Input and output】The printer supports multiple media sizes, including A4, B5, A6, DL envelope, legal and has a 100-sheet input tray and a 30-sheet output tray for efficient paper handling.
【Easy-to-use interface】Navigate through printing tasks easily with 33 segments + 1.2-inch Icon LCD display and Power On/Off, Cancel, Resume, Color copy, Black copy, ID copy, Wi-Fi, and Info buttons.
【Compatible OS】The HP Smart Tank 580 printer is compatible with Windows 11/10 and macOS 10.15/11/12, allowing you to print from a variety of devices.
【3000-page duty cycle】Ideal for home and small office use, this printer offers a robust duty cycle of up to 3,000 pages per month.
